name: Khudal
description: A feline-headed rakshasa demon who serves Tasigur, uses a poisoning to arrange Yala's death so he can feed on her soul, and abandons the Sultai.

description_citations.work: The Doom of the Golden Fang
description_citations.text: "The Doom of the Golden Fang" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Feb 2015.

timeline.summary: Tasigur has Shidiqi take him to the rakshasa Khudal, who names Yala as the poisoner in exchange for the right to feed on the traitor's soul.
timeline.quote: Yala, whom you honored before your throne yesterday, has done this.

citation.work: The Doom of the Golden Fang
citation.text: "The Doom of the Golden Fang" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Feb 2015.

timeline.summary: Khudal reveals the poison was his own, that he lied so he could feast on Yala's soul, and Tasigur, in rage, has robbed him of that prize.
timeline.quote: No," Khudal said. "The poison was mine."

citation.work: The Doom of the Golden Fang
citation.text: "The Doom of the Golden Fang" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Feb 2015.

timeline.summary: Khudal and Shidiqi abandon Tasigur with the prophecy 'And so the Sultai fall'; the naga and rakshasa leave the Sultai.
timeline.quote: And so the Sultai fall," the naga echoed, and she was gone, too.

citation.work: The Doom of the Golden Fang
citation.text: "The Doom of the Golden Fang" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Feb 2015.
